newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Qatar awards fourth quarter oil products tender.
newsitem.headline: Qatar awards fourth quarter oil products tender.

text.p: State-owned Qatar General Petroleum Corporation (QGPC) has sold a total of 325,000 tonnes of refined oil products in its tender for fourth-quarter loadings, industry sources said on Thursday.

They said QGPC accepted bids from oil companies for five 25,000-tonne sized cargoes of gas oil, three 20,000-tonne cargoes of jet fuel, three 20,000-tonne cargoes of gasoline and two 40,000-tonne of fuel oil.
Kuwait-based Independent Petroleum Group won one October, one November and two December liftings of gasoil at about 90 cents per barrel over MidEast spot prices.
